ios.desc:
The PayPal POS app (ex Zettle) empowers you to easily and seamlessly accept in-person payments. From accepting card, contactless, e-wallet payments to tracking sales, PayPal POS has a suite of payment solution to fit your business' needs. Whether you’re running a coffee shop, clothing store or barber shop, PayPal POS is the one app you need accept payments, manage inventory, and track sales in one complete app. No monthly fees, no set-up costs and no lock-in contracts.

The PayPal POS app is free to download and comes with a range of features:
• Simplify your inventory management with an intuitive product library
• Accept contactless payments with TTP or accept payment types including card, contactless, e-wallets, and more with the Card Reader or Terminal
• Customize receipts and print, text or email them to your customers
• Collect sales data and use easy-to-understand reports to grow your business
• Create multiple staff accounts to track individuals’ sales
• Benefit from a wide range of integrations, including Accounting and E-commerce integrations as well as integrations specially tailored for restaurants, retail, and health & beauty business


How do I get started?

1. Download the PayPal POS app and sign up for an account
2. Start taking card payments immediately with TTP, or order your PayPal Reader, with rapid delivery (2-3 working days)

Tap to Pay: Quickly and easily capture contactless in-person payments on-the-go with just your phone and the Point of Sale app. Just download the app and start selling. No storefront or additional hardware required.

PayPal Reader and Dock:
The new PayPal Reader and Dock are quick to set up and easy to use, allowing you to accept all major credit cards and contactless payments - including Apple Pay. A clear pricing model without fixed costs or fixed contracts. The PayPal Reader meets all requirements from the payment industry and is EMV-approved and PCI DSS-compliant.

*A stable WiFi and Bluetooth connection may be required

Our groundbreaking iOS app has truly made an impression on the mobile payments market.

We released the first version back in 2011 and the rest is, as you know, history.

With that being said, we are never satisfied. When our user base grows, the demands on our app increases. We're dedicated to delivering stable software that our users can trust and love to use. There is always new features to be developed, new technologies to be used, new architecture to be tested and new problems to be solved. 
We're constantly revisiting previous solutions; turning them into small, reusable, testable and maintainable components. Furthermore introduction of Swift has opened up for new solutions and ways of thinking.

We are a small, well oiled team that live and breathe Apple. As part of that team, you will have the opportunity to influence every aspect of our app; from UI animations down to peripheral hardware integrations. 
You will discuss technical solutions with the team, and together we'll build amazing software that we can be proud of. We are keen to share our knowledge and to learn new things. We’re always on the lookout for new technologies, methods and different ways to solve new problems.

If you want to join us, you’re probably a proven asset within iOS development. We’re looking for developers who we can learn from and help us take our app to the next level.
